parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: Correct ordered back-to-back diagram with key, e.g. $6|3|2$ means 36 cm in Dados and 32 cm in Linva.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Official back-to-back diagram, Dados on the left and Linva on the right: stem 0 has Dados leaves $8,6$ and Linva leaves $0,2,9$; stem 1 has Dados leaves $6,5,2,0,0$ and Linva leaves $0,1,2,5,6$; stem 2 has Dados leaves $8,2$ and no Linva leaves; stem 3 has Dados leaf $6$ and Linva leaves $2,6$; stem 4 has Dados leaf $2$ and Linva leaf $0$. Key: $6|3|2$ means 36 cm (snow) in Dados and 32 cm (snow) in Linva. B1 correct stem; B1 correct Dados leaves/order/alignment; B1 correct Linva leaves/order/alignment; B1 correct single key with both resorts and cm. SC: two separate diagrams meeting both key criteria score maximum B0B1B0SCB1. [4]

steps.working: Linva leaves: $0,2,9$ at stem 0; $0,1,2,5,6$ at stem 1; none at 2; $2,6$ at 3; $0$ at 4, ordered and aligned.
Gives a complete key, e.g. $6|3|2$ means 36 cm in Dados and 32 cm in Linva.
steps.guidance: Two separate diagrams can earn the published special-case marks when both keys are complete.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Median or $Q_2=15$ cm (B1). $Q_3=28$ cm and $Q_1=10$ cm, so IQR $=28-10$ (M1; acceptable bounds $22\le Q_3\le36$ and $8\le Q_1\le10$). IQR $=18$ cm (A1, WWW). [3]

parts.label: (c)
parts.answer: On average snowfall is higher in Dados; snowfall varies more in Linva.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: On average the snowfall in Davos is higher (B1 FT from their 5(b); statement comparing central tendency in context). The amount of snowfall in Linva varies more than in Davos (B1 FT; statement comparing spread in context). Official MS prints “Davos” although the QP names the resort “Dados”; retained verbatim. Simply stating and comparing values is insufficient. [2]

steps.working: Dados has the higher median ($15$ cm compared with $12$ cm), so its weekly snowfall is higher on average.
steps.guidance: The official MS prints “Davos”; this is the QP resort Dados. Follow through part (b).

steps.working: Linva has the larger IQR ($23$ cm compared with $18$ cm), so its weekly snowfall varies more.
